text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's really pouring today. I guess I won't be able to use the track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sigh… So foggy… I can't even see any of the scenery outside…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Maybe Spe and I should make sunshine dolls to wish for good weather.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka appears to be down in the dumps since she can't go on her daily jog.
